strategy_roster.name: TwoPerBar Ron
strategy_roster.notes: A positive completed-bar return is a single-direction proxy for the profitable long leg of the per-bar hedge. Fixed cash targets, simultaneous short orders, martingale sizing, and point-based management are not expressible in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: BrainTrend2 V2 Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: EMA alignment with compressed ATR approximates the documented bullish river state; the exact weighted river and five indicator colors are unavailable. ATR(7) is documented, while the slower EMA and smoothing lengths are fallbacks; point stops are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Hammer & Hanging Man with CCI Confirmation
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < sma(close,5) and close > open and close - low >= 2 * (close - open) and close >= low + 0.67 * (high - low) and rsi(close,11) < 40
strategy_roster.notes: A long lower wick below SMA(5) approximates a hammer in a downtrend, with RSI(11)<40 standing in for documented CCI confirmation below 40. Exact prior-candle gap, CCI, and vote-based exits are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: AdaptiveTrader Pro
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,14),50) and ema(close,20) > ema(close,50) and close > ema(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish RSI(14) momentum cross is confirmed by the documented 20/50 moving-average trend pair as a same-timeframe translation of the oversold/overbought regime logic. The 1-hour confirmation, spread filter, and ATR(14) trailing and partial-target logic cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: Williams R Slope Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar return slope scored at two standard deviations approximates the unavailable Williams %R slope breakout, and reversion below its mean exits. The documented 2% stop is retained; other direction-side execution is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Daydream
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 25-candle channel becomes a prior-bar Donchian breakout with the mirrored breakdown as exit. One-action throttling and the 15-pip virtual trailing take-profit cannot be encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Expert610 Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A prior-candle high break shortly after an ATR expansion proxies the wide-candle pending-order setup. Threshold and offset pips, paired pending orders, and the 5/10-pip protections are not expressible as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Virtual Stop Manager
strategy_roster.notes: The positive-price guard represents the source's unconditional first-candle long, while the impossible negative-price exit preserves its state-managed nature. Point values are unspecified and virtual trailing, break-even, stop, and target state cannot be expressed.

strategy_roster.name: ATR Normalize Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: The close-to-low stream normalized by smoothed ATR is a direct proxy for the histogram, with the documented middle level 50 separating long states. Unspecified smoothing lengths use 10, 60/50/40 color levels and signal shifts are omitted, and point stops remain null.

strategy_roster.name: Gap Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: For a long-only roster, a downside opening gap below the prior low selects the expected upward mean reversion, and a bullish close exits. The one-price-step minimum gap, 15-minute schedule, and short-side gap are omitted.
